international.title: FAA chief urges critics to ‘lay off’ Sean Duffy for flight stoppage: ‘Blame me’
international.summary: Comments come as the top US transportation official faces scrutiny over his handling of tech outage crisis The head of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) took responsibility for the nationwide ground stop that affected more than 12,400 flights on Friday, urging people to “lay off” Sean Duffy, the transportation secretary. “I take full responsibility for it,” Bryan Bedford, the FAA administrator, said at an aviation event staged by the Hill on Wednesday .
